items.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: Chuck Berry even was on that show

ctx.x: That’s where they’d have guys come out and do a couple of hits and the bands would back them up. Right? And then the next guy would come out.
Right. Right. Frankie Lymon and the Teenagers, and the Platters, and Chuck Berry even was on that show, and Frankie Lymon and the Teenagers. Did I say that already?
